major_concerns: Simulator/oracle fidelity vs vendor semantics may limit external validity
LLM output parsing/normalization could introduce bias before validation
Perturbation magnitudes and their operational interpretation are underspecified
Single-model evaluation risk — generality claims would be weak
Power/sample-size and seed/randomization plans not detailed
required_design_repairs: Specify exact validator implementation (algorithms, assumptions) and publish its code
Define numeric perturbation magnitudes with operational justification and include sanity checks
Detail parsing/normalization pipeline and instrument parser errors as exclusions
Include at least one additional model family or justify single-model choice; report model identifiers and prompt templates
Provide power analysis/sample-size justification and fixed random seeds; preregister exclusion rules

major_concerns: Adversarial payload realism and representativeness are under-specified
Ethical/safety risk of publishing attack payloads and accidental replication of real vulnerabilities
Defense tuning to the known corpus may overstate real-world robustness
Tool-sandbox simulation may not capture live integration subtleties
required_design_repairs: Add explicit ethical safeguards and a responsible-disclosure policy; limit experiments to simulated environments and public corpora
Preregister adversarial-corpus construction rules; include procedurally generated variants to reduce tuning bias
Define and publish sandboxed tool interfaces; ensure no real device access and document limitations
Include at least two different LLM families or clearly justify scope; publish model/prompt details
Measure and report false-block/false-reject trade-offs and operational costs for each defense

major_concerns: Availability and licensing of permissively redistributable configuration fragments may limit dataset representativeness
Benchmark design choices (task difficulty, adversary selection, oracles) could bias outcomes
Simulated oracles may omit production semantics, risking misalignment with operational safety
Risk of overclaiming generality without multi-vendor coverage
Reproducibility requires comprehensive artifact packaging (seeds, scripts, hashes)
required_design_repairs: Audit and document license provenance for every dataset item; fallback to procedurally synthesized vendor-agnostic fragments if necessary
Precisely specify oracle semantics (reachability/ACL/loop detection) with formal definitions and test suites
Publish complete evaluation code, seeds, prompt templates, and artifact hashes in a public repo
Include a clear adversary-construction protocol and report how adversarial cases were sampled
Provide baseline model outputs and evaluation scripts to enable independent replication

major_concerns: Validator brittleness may produce misleading 'stability' signals causing premature stopping
Stopping-rule tuning risk — heuristics may overfit the selected task set
Task diversity may be insufficient to characterize plateau dynamics broadly
Definitions of 'plateau' and improvement thresholds are underspecified
required_design_repairs: Define operational criteria for plateau (numeric thresholds) and justify them in preregistration
Include multiple validator implementations or sensitivity analyses to validator error rates
Preregister a diverse task corpus stratified by complexity; report per-stratum results
Compare proposed stopping rules to a human-in-the-loop baseline or conservative oracle where feasible
